tataḥ kalpitakriyāviśeṣa eva cirakṣiprādayo na tāttvikāḥ
kathamitthaṃ tathetyete padārthavyatirekiṇaḥ | bhaveyurvyatirekasya vikalpāḥ sādhakā yadi || 44
yadi yo ya eva vikalpa udayavān tadartharūpaḥ sa eva padārthaḥ kalpanāviṣayaḥ pāramārthikaḥ tadaivamādayopi padārthāḥ syuḥ cetkvāntarbhāvyaṃtām
atha te kriyāviśeṣā eva tathā sati cirādayopīti vyarthakaḥ kālādikalpanāprayāsaḥ
na hi tatrānupraviṣṭamanyatrāpi tadā bhavati bhedābhāvena sarvvānupraveśa ekapiṇḍatā syāt
atha samānametad dvayamiti dhīrudeti tataḥ sāmānyaṃ bhinnābhinnaṃ
dhiyaḥ samānākāratve kathamarthasamānatā | na hyanyatra samānatve tatsamānaḥ paro bhavet || 45
arthe samānākāraścet syādbhedena vedyatām | adṛ (śya) mānamartheṣu kathamartheṣu kalpyatām || 46
nahi vacanamavivecitārthameva yathākathañcit pratīyamānārthamarthasya sattyatāṃ vidadhāti
svarūpasamānākāratve svarūpameva tadbhavet nārthaḥ samānākārayogīti sāmānyamarthaḥ
sa ca buddhyākāraḥ svalakṣaṇameva na tat sāmānyaṃ
athārthākāra eva samāna iti tadākārā dhīriti vacaḥ
svadṛṣṭau pakṣapātena vaco nātra pratītitaḥ | arthaḥ sidhyetsamastasya dhvaneḥ sarvvatra vṛttitaḥ || 47
atha sāsnādimattvena samānākāratā tadavyatiriktalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ deśakālaviniyatavyaktyantareṇa yuktamiti na doṣaḥ
ākṛterapi naikatvaṃ pratyakṣeṇa tathā'grahāt | ekatvādekavijñāne sarvvavyaktigraho bhavet || 48
nahi bhinnaṃ grahītuṃ śakyamanyattu tādātmyādeva gṛhyate
tadātmanā hi tādātmyaṃ na tu tādātmyamucyate | pāramparyeṇa tadātmye'bheda eva prasajyate || 49
yadi cākṛtimatastadabhinnasya na grahaṇaṃ ākṛtyantaragrahaṇepi tadantaragrahaṇanna bhavet na hyabhedo grahaṇanibandhanamākṛtimadagrahaṇāt
kārṣṇyādi vyatiriktañcetadbhedādbheditā kutaḥ | tatsaṃsargeṇa bheda/?/cet ākṛterapyasau na kiṃ || 50
nahi guṇā eva dravyasya kāraṇaṃ tadekayogakṣematayodayāt
kāraṇatve vā tasmādaparo bhinna udeti tasyāpyapareṇa saṃsargiṇā bhedakena bhavitavyaṃ
saṃsargiṇopi tarhi kāraṇatvaṃ na dṛṣṭamiti na kāraṇatvaṃ kalpanīyaṃ
abhedapakṣe bhedaścet ākṛterapi bhinnatā | bhinnādabhinnaṃ bhinnaṃ hi nānyathā bhinnatā bhavet || 51
ākṛtimato (') bhinnaṃ kārṣṇyādikaṃ tato bhinnādabhinnaṃ yattadapi bhinnamityākṛtimato bhedaḥ
bhede vaktumidaṃ yuktaṃ abhedenāvibhāgataḥ | idamatra na cedaṃ hi kalpanā bhinnabhāvinī || 52
atha paramārthataḥ sarvvameva pratibhāsitaṃ bhrāntyā tvapratibhāsa iti vibhramaḥ
sarvvasyāpratibhāsaḥ kiṃ pratibhāsepi vā bhramaḥ | pramāṇamatra nāstyeva kevalā kalpanaiva tu || 54
kāraṇe śaktirūpeṇa sarvveṣāmeva yā sthitiḥ | tataḥ pradhānantatsarvvajagatāmudyodyaḥ || 55
tadeva yadi sāmānya vyāpi nityatayā sthiteḥ | vyaktirvyaktirdṛśyamānāparasparavibhedataḥ || 56
guṇānāṃ sumahadrūṃpa na dṛṣṭipathamṛcchati | yattu dṛṣṭipathaprāptaṃ tanmāyeva sutucchakaṃ || 57
kāryadvāreṇa yatkalpyaṃ tasya tucchatayā nanu | tasyāpi tucchatā hetau tadrūpasyaiva sambhavāt || 58
athānyadeva satkāryavādaḥ samprati hīyate | yacca naivekṣyate vastu tadevāpāramārthikaṃ || 59

tatra nāsti samānā (? samā)kāraḥ pratyakṣeṇa samīkṣitaḥ
yaḥ samānākāraḥ sa sakalo nirālambanaḥ pratyayaḥ
tadyathā bhinnakālavyaktisāmānyālambanābhimataḥ apratibhāsamānasāmānyākāraśca samānakālavyaktisāmānyaviṣayopi pratyaya iti svabhāvahetuḥ

āropito ya ākāro vāsanā bījabodhataḥ | tāvanmātreṇa paryāptaṃjātiranyā vṛthā na kim || 63

dharmādharmaprasidhyartha jātiścetpāramārthikī | dharmasādhanatā tasyāḥ kena mānena mīyatām || 64
dharmādisādhanatvaṃ hi jāteḥ svarūpeṇa prasiddhādapi na vivekena gamyate jātyantarādabhedāt

atha yadi sāmānyaṃ nittyaṃ vyāpi na bhavetsamānākāra eva vyāpī na bhavet pratyayaḥ
prasaṅgasādhanamidaṃ nāśrayāsiddhatā tataḥ | yadyevaṃ syādidamapi na cobhayamitīṣṭitaḥ || 66
nanu yadyanyenayoga ekavyaktiniṣṭhatvaṃ na syāt siddhasāvyatā naikasyāṃ vyaktau sthitiḥ sarvvavyaktivyāpitvāt
sādhāraṇatve tasya syādvayāpitāvittirakṣataḥ | nahi tadrūpamanyena rūpeṇa grāhyamabhramaṃ || 67
yadi vyāpi sāmānyaṃ vyāpitayaivādhyakṣaṇe pramāṇena gṛhyeta
yadi ca vyāpitā pratīyate sakalavyaktipratītireva bhavet
na ca pratīyate tato na tathārūpaṃ
atha sāmānyamanyathānupapattyā pratīyamānaṃ sakalāparapadārthavilakṣaṇameva na tasyānya-
amūrtentyaviśeṣepi vyāpitā neṣyate paraiḥ | tadvadavyāpitā prāptā sāmānyasyāpi gṛhyatām || 68
yepi khalvamūrttisaṅgatā antyā viśeṣāstepi pratiniyatādhiṣṭhānā na vyāpinaḥ
sāmānyaviśeṣabhāva eva tarhi vyāpitetaratve nibandhanambhavatu ko doṣa iti cet
vyāpitā'gragahaṇe sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ kathamucyatāṃ | svarūpeṇa grahastasya yadi sāmyaṃ tataḥ katham || 69
) svarūpeṇa hi gṛhyamāṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ vyapitayetarathā vā gṛhyeta
vyāpitāgrahaṇañcet na pratyakṣasyeyatī gatiḥ | yadaśeṣavyaktivyāpisāmānye'sya pravarttanaṃ || 70
tathā tarhi sāmānyamekavyaktisamanvitaṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ kathaṃ vyāpitayā gṛhītaṃ
tathā sati tadevedaṃ sāmānyamiti kathaṃ gatiḥ
dharmitvena sāmānyasyopādāne tatra dharmasyaṃ kasyacitsādhanaṃ nānyathā
yadi tvayā sāmānyaṃ vyāpyabhyupagamyate pramāṇena tatpratipattavyaṃ
deśakālāvacchinnaikavyaktisaṃsargāvacchinnasvabhāvāntaravirahatayā ca pratīyamānaṃ kathaṃ vyāpi taditi abhyupagantuṃ yuktaṃ
pratyakṣeṇa cānekavastugrahaṇena tadvyatiriktaṃ anyathā vā pratīyata iti nāpratīyamānābhyupagamo yuktaḥ
ekavyaktiniṣṭhatve cākṛtera (pya) yāpitā sādhane dharmyasiddhirapi parihṛtaiva
sāmānyaṃ yadi dharmi syāttatrāvyāpitvasādhanaṃ | abhāvamātrake hetau kva kiṅkena prasādhyatām || 72
na ca pakṣadharmopasaṃhāramantareṇa hetuḥ samarthaḥ sādhyasādhanāya
athānyāpohalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ siddhaṃ saugatānāṃ tathāsati parasyeṣṭameva
atastatsāmarthyādyatra vyāpako nāsti tatra vyāpyābhāva iti vipakṣe'bhāvamātramādarśyate
tathā sati nātra śiṃśapeti nyāyādanyena dharmiṇā bhavitavyaṃ pramāṇaprasiddhena
rūpādaya eva sāmānyamiti pakṣe nedaṃ prasaṅgasādhanaṃ
tasmādubhayavādisiddhi eva heturnna tvanyatarasya prativādina eva
nanu ya ubhayasiddhaḥ so'rtha eva kimarthamarthagrahaṇaṃ
kalpanānāmātrataḥ siddho yathaikasyobhayorapi | kalpanā hi na na nāmaitā niyatodayasaṅgamāḥ || 74
yadi cāsya trairupyamasti kathamaheturatha trairūpyābhāvastadā svārthānumānalakṣaṇādeva nivṛttiḥ kimarthagrahaṇena
kathaṃ tato nivṛttirnnātra tarhi tadgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam
svaniścayavadanyasya vacanamapi sādhanamiṣyate 'yuktavādinasta iti pratipāditaṃ bhavati
svaniścayavaditi yāvad vacanamapi sādhanamiti na labhyate bhāṣāntare, madhye caturdaśī kārikā'pi luptā
kalpanādi kṛtaṃ hetuṃ svārthe kaścinna kalpayet | ātmānameva kiṃ kaścidvisamvādayatīhitāt || 75
parārtha eva yatna paraḥ kārya iti cātraiva mahān yatno vidheyo mahātmanetyarthagrahaṇamatra
na hi pakṣasapakṣāntaratvaṃ nittyānittyayorekatra niyataṃ yo yaḥ pakṣīkriyate tadapekṣayā tatra tatra sañcārāt
nanu pakṣaḥ sādhya eva tadapekṣayānyasya sapakṣatvāt
na pakṣasya sapakṣasya bhāvasya niyamaḥ kvacit | na pakṣonityatā mātramaparasyāpi sambhavāt || 76
na tva vyabhicārī dharmaḥ kṛtakatvādilakṣaṇa eva
evaṃ ca sati (sa) heturartha eva na kalpitaḥ
yadyapi nāmānityatayā pakṣatvavivakṣā tathāpi na tāvatā'nityatā sidhyati
vāstavañcedanityatayā pakṣatvaṃ prasidhyet siddhameva sādhitaṃ bhavet
tato yaiḥ pakṣavacanamapi sādhanamiṣyate'yuktavādinasta iti pratipāditaṃ bhavati
anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvāditi trirūpaṃ kṛtakatvamevānityatāṃ gamayati
tathā sādhanārthopi naiva tasmātpratipattavyaḥ tatrāpi naiva tasya pratibandhaḥ

varttamāne tu pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣameva kintatra vacanena
pāramparyeṇa tarhi sādhanaṃ pakṣasya vacanaṃ yathā sādhanasya
yathā sādhanavacanaṃ sādhanaṃ tathā pakṣavacanamapi bhavet
na patantamāśritya patat sthirībhavati kvacit | tathā (') siddhamasiddhena na tenaiva prasādhyate || 77
pratibaddhasya sādhyerthe sādhanasyābhidhānataḥ | vacanaṃ sādhanaṃ proktaṃ sādhanaṃ tatsvato na tu || 78
parārthatā tasya pratipādakāpekṣayā na pratipādakasya tena kakcidupakāraḥ
yenaiva tasya pratipādakasya tadanumānanna bhavati pratipādyasya vāta eva tat pratipādakasya parārthamanyathā svārthamapi bhavet
smaraṇe ca tatkārakaṃ na jñāpakamiti pramāṇasvabhāvaḥ
ghamo hi pāvake pratibaddha iti janayati smaraṇaṃ
tathāhi yadyatsmaraṇaṃ tadasti pratibandhataḥ | yathāsti dhūmātsmaraṇaṃ parokṣe kṛṣṇava'tmani || 79
ābhogadapi dṛṣṭerthe smaraṇaṃ kinna jāyate | yataḥ kutaścidarthādvā prāyeṇa sahacāriṇaḥ || 80
na hyasati pratibandhe tasya niścayastatra kintu śabdānniścitarūpaṃ smaraṇamityasiddhamato na sambandhasiddhiḥ
etadiṣyata evātra pramāṇe tatsvato nahi | asminnarthe prasiddhepi na kācinnaḥ kṣatiryataḥ || 81
pramāṇe tu pramāṇamiti naiva kiñcit kṣīyate na ca pramāṇamapi vacanātsidhyati tasya svasamvedanena siddheḥ
atha yadābhogato na bhavati tadā vacane pramāṇamiti cet
mithyāsmaraṇamapyarthe vacanājjātamīkṣyate | vacanasya viśeṣo na sattyāsattyatayekṣyate || 82
īkṣaṇerthonumānantatsvārthameva tadā bhavet | ābhogādapi jāyante mithyā smaraṇavṛttayaḥ || 83
tasmātpūrvvapramāṇasvarūpāvadhāraṇamatyantaparyālocanata eva kutaścit liṅgāditi na vacanaṃ pramāṇaṃ
pramāṇātsmaraṇaṃ jātamupacārātpramā na kiṃ | apramāṇāttu yajjātamapramāṇantadiṣyate3 || 84
tadapi smaraṇamanyataḥ smaraṇātpariśuddhibhāgiti kuto niścayo jāyatāṃ
dṛḍhaṃ smaraṇametaccenmithyā dāḍha‌ryanna kimmataṃ | arthaprāpternna mithyā cet siddhopasthānameva tat || 85
nanu svata eva kiñcid dṛḍhaṃ smaraṇaṃ tatoyaṃ pramāṇaditi niścayo na vyavahārāditi cet
abhyāsādeva dṛḍhatā sāsti prāptisamāśrayāt | anyadabhyastamanyatra dṛḍhatā naiva jāyate || 86

āgamādeva siddhoyaṃ yadyarthaḥ kiṃ pratijñayā | āgamānna prasiddhoyaṃ yadyarthaḥ kiṃ (pra) tijñayā || 96

na khalu kaścitpramāṇaprasiddha āptaḥ parasya sakalamanodoṣarahitasya jñātumaśakyatvādasarvvadarśinā (
yadi sarvameva mithyā vaktavyaṃ mayeti bhavatobhyupagamaḥ
na madvacamātkiñcit karttavyamevaṃ tarhi kimātmā parikleśito vayaṃ (?) cāvacanepyasyārthasya siddhatvāt
yathā sarvvaṃ mithyā pabravīmīti naitadeva niṣidhyate
tasya mithyābhidhāne hi prakrāntortho na sidhyatī || 65 || ti
kālatrayaniṣedhepi na(cai)tat saṅgataṃ vacaḥ | aprāmāṇye hi vacasaḥ prakhyātyā panayo bhavet || 165
atha varttamānānāgataniṣedha idaṃ bravīmi mithyā tadāpi kimanenoktena
bhāvini tu śrotaiva nāsti kimarthaṃ vacanaṃ
tathā śāstraprasiddherthe tadanabhyupagame vicārasyeti sāmyameva śāstrasvavacanayoḥ
yadi śāstramantareṇa vicāro na pravarttate dharmiṇa evābhāvāt(
) tadā śāstraṃ bādhakamanyathā neti pratipādayituṃ sahoktimantareṇa(tu) śāstraṃ svavacanādatiriktasāmarthyaṃ pareṣāmabhimatamiti
pramāṇapratiṣedhe śāstramapi naiva bhavataḥ pramāṇamiti kimabhyupagama iti parasparavirodhamātrameva syāt
yadi tu pramāṇaṃ kiñcinna syāt kuto dharmyādisiddhiriti svavacanavirodhaḥ
yata eva tasya siddhistadeva tasya pramāṇambhavet
pramāṇamantareṇa tu na kiñcijjñāyata iti vaktavyaṃ
śāstramabhyupagamya yadi brūyāt syādeveti na doṣaḥ
ata eva na śāstravirodhe spaṣṭamidaṃ udāharaṇaṃ
evantarhi yatra pramāṇasiddho dharmī tatra śāstramabhyupagamyamānaṃ bādhakameva pramāṇatvāt
śāstraprasiddhe tu dharmiṇi tadabhyupagataṃ taduparodhādeva tadvādhakaṃ bhavet
na bādhā pratibandhaḥ syāt tulyakakṣya tayā dvayo ḥ || 98
tatastulyaśaktitvād dvayorapi pratibandha eva na bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ
tayoḥ pramāṇaṃ yasyāsti tat syādanyasya bādhakaṃ || 99
svavacanopagamavirodhayostarhi kathaṃ pṛthakkaraṇaṃ parasparaṃ nyā ya mu khe
yathau lū kya syānityaḥ śabda iti sādhayataḥ viṣayabhedābhāvepi hi pṛthagudāharaṇamanarthakaṃ
sattyamabheda eva, tathāpi pūrvveṇa pratiṣṭhāpitamuttaraṃ pratihantītyabhyupagamavirodhaḥ
tadeva tu vākyaṃ svārthaṃ pratihantīti svavacanavirodhaḥ
evantarhi svavāgvirodhe'bhyupagamyamāne svāvāk‌chāstravirodhayorabheda eva prāpto na śāstrabādhavailakṣaṇyaṃ
atha śāstraṃ svārthasādhanāyābhyupagatamiti pramāṇaṃ svavacanantu parārthantato na nitarāṃ
parārthe hi na mahān prayatna iti
parīkṣitaṃ yadi bhavetpramāṇaṃ tatra bādhakaṃ | parīkṣā na pravṛttā cet svavāco na viśiṣyate || 166
yadi parīkṣitamabhyupagataṃ tadā tadarthapramāṇata eva siddha iti pramāṇabādhaiva
atha na parīkṣitaṃ vacanamātrameva taditi na viśeṣaḥ svavacanādāgamasya
pramāṇena prasiddhe dharmiṇi vicārasyāpratibandhācchāstraṃ parityajatopi na kācit kṣatiḥ
abhyupagamya virodhāt nāsau śāstravirodhasya parisphuṭo viṣayaḥ
evaṃ tarhi tacchāstraṃ pratiṣṭhāpayan dharmiṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati tatastadbādhakaṃ
tattarhi śāstramapramāṇakaṃ kathaṃ dharmiṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati prāmāṇyenābhyupagamāt
svopagama eva tarhi prāmāṇyamāda (dha) t dharmiṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
dharmāntarañca sa eva prativahatīti na bhidyate svavacanavirodhācchāstravirodhaḥ
cittamantargataṃ duṣṭaṃ tīrthasnānairna śudhyati | śataśopi hi taddhautaṃ surābhāṇḍamivāśuci || 167
gaṅgādvāre kuśāvartte vilvakī nīlaparvate | snātvā kaṇakhale tīrthe sambhavenna pu(na)rbhavaḥ || 168
yadi tarhi na kiñcid bādhyate virodhamātrakameva kimarthantarhi tadabhyupagamavirodha ityāha
śāstraṃ yatsiddhayā yuktyā svavācā ca na bādhyate
abhyupagamakṛto hi tatra pratibandho na tu pramāṇaprasiddha iti na mukhyaḥ kāryahetuḥ
tatra prasiddherapi yadi vāstavaḥ pratibandhastadā mukhya eva svabhāvahetuḥ
anumānasya bhedena sā bādhoktā caturvvidho iti vacanāt
ā cā rye ṇāpi yatrāpītyādivacanena pṛthagudāharaṇapradarśanena cāturvvidhyamupadarśitaṃ na samarthitaṃ syāt
sarvvalokavirodhoyaṃ pūrvvakaḥ punarātmanā | svabhāvakāryarūpeṇa prasaṅgoyaṃ kṛtothavā || 169
nanu śāstrasvavacanayorna kaścidbheda iti svavacanabādhaiva śāstrabādhā
tatonyaṃ pratipādayatā śāstraprasiddhe dharmiṇi vivādamāracayatāvaśyameva svavacanaśāstravacanayoḥ pramāṇatābhyupagantavyā
tatra hi mātā ca bandhyā ceti na vivakṣitārthabādhā
tadā nittyatvādayopi sakalalokaprasiddhāstatastadbādhane pramāṇena lokaprasiddhibādhā bhavedanyeṣāñca pramāṇaviruddhānāṃ
) tathā sati nittyātmādīnāmapi bādhane doṣaḥ syāt
pramāṇasiddhaṃ śāstreṇa nāpanetuṃ hi śakyate | bādhitatvāt pramāṇena prāmāṇyavinivṛttitaḥ || 173
iṣṭaśabdābhidheyatvasya tu na tathā calanamanumānasya bādhakasyābhāvāt
svasamveda(na)meva pramāṇaṃ tena vācyatvasya śabdaṃ pratyupādānopādeyabhāvalakṣaṇasya siddhatvāt
yadyevaṃ pratyakṣa (siddha) meva (ā)vācyatvaṃ tataḥ pratyakṣabādhita eva pakṣaḥ
kāryakāraṇabhāva eva pratyakṣaprasiddho nāparo vācyavācakabhāva iti cet
bācyatvamatra sāmānyaṃ bhāvibhūtatayā sthitaṃ | vyāpivyaktestatastasya kutaḥ pratyakṣato gatiḥ || 172
kevalaṃ vyavahārasya tathābhūtasya bhāvataḥ | anādivāsanābhāvāt tadastīti pratīyate || 173
tacca na pratiṣeddhaṃ śakyaṃ vāsanāpratiniyamena tathābhūtapratyayodayāt
sā ca vāsanecchāmātrakṛtasaṅketaniyamena prabodhitā niyataṃ sāmānyamavasthāpayati
yattu tasyādṛṣṭahetutvaṃ tadatra sādhyamanyathā caṇḍālādijātīnāmāsāñca kaḥ parasparato vibhāgaḥ
vāhadohādisāmarthyamātreṇātra prayojanaṃ | tenopalakṣyamāṇatvaṃ na nāmātra na saṃgataṃ || 175
tasmād vikalpya viṣayatvameva jātirataḥ prasiddhimātraprāpitātmabhāvatvāt sa dharmo vyavahārajaḥ
nahi vyavahārārtha śabdamupanibadhya viracito vaidyādivyapadeśaviṣayaḥ sarvvavirodhyanunmattena pratiṣedhyaḥ prasiddhaḥ
svabhāvata eva yogyaṃ tadāśrayabhuvāṃ vyavahārajātānāṃ yogyaṃ gotvādīnāṃ viśvaṃ
kṛtānāmakṛtānāñca svayaṃ vyutpādayiṣyamāṇānāṃ yogyameva viśvasya sarvvatrāpratikūlatvāt
na khalu bhāvinī bhūtā vā yogyatā pratiṣedhena nivarttayituṃ śakyā śabdasya agnihotraṃ juhuyātsvargakāma ityādeḥ śvamāṃsabhakṣaṇādau
na hi kaścidarthaḥ pratikūlaḥ saṃ ketakaraṇe dṛṣṭa upadeśapratipanno vā
yā ca yogyatā'rthamātrānurodhinī na tatra kaścit pratiṣedhe nyāyaḥ
yogyatā hi prasiddheḥ kāraṇanna tu prasiddhireva
ācāryasyāpyayamevābhiprāyo yogyataiva śābdaprasiddhavacanena pratipādyate na nirvṛttā vācyatā
icchāmātreṇa vṛttirhi dhvaneḥ sarvvatra vastuni | tanmātravṛttiryaḥ śabdaḥ sa kathaṃ kvāpi varttatāṃ || 176
nahi vastu svarūpeṇa pravarttayati vācakaṃ | aprātikūlyaṃ saṃkete yogyatetyabhidhīyate || 177
icchayā nirmitiryaiva sārthamātrānurodhitā | arthamātrepyanākāṃkṣā saṃketecchā kathambhavet || 178
nanvaprātikūlyaṃ yogyatā sā kathaṃ bhāvinī bhūtā vā
arthasya bhāvibhūtatvād yogyatāpi tathā vidhā | svarūpavyatiriktā hi yogyatā nāma nekṣyate || 180
tatra yortho yena śabdenā (bhi) dhātumiṣṭaḥ sa tena śabdenābhidhātuṃ yogyastadyathā vṛkṣaśabdena nahi kasyacit kvāpi pratikūlatā
nanu dṛṣṭānta eva na siddhastatrāpi pratikṣepasaṃbhavāt
evaṃ tarhi pratyakṣabādhita eva pratijñārthaḥ kiṃ prasiddhibādhayā
sarvve śabdāḥ kvaciddeśe kāle vā vācakā matāḥ | nyāyenānena na hyatra pratyakṣasya pravarttanam || 182
yadapi candraśabdābhidheyatvaṃ yadā ghaṭe pratiṣidhyate tadā (pi) prasiddhibādhanamiti
athānyasya na pratibhāsate na cedānīṃ vā
kimiti na sambhāvyate deśakālanarāntare (ṇa) śabdārthānāmanyathā vācyavācakabhāvadṛṣṭeḥ kuto niyamaḥ
anena nyāyena sarvvaṃ sarvvavācyamiṣṭamiti na doṣaḥ
khādecch‪vamāṃsamityeṣa yenārthaḥ pratiṣidhyate | pratītibādhitatvena sa yogyatvena bādhyate || 183
nanu ya eva saṃketaparataṃtrā laukikāḥ śabdāsteṣvevāyamaniyamaḥ
vyavahārārthañca saṃketo dṛṣṭaviṣaya evamukto'tīndriye tu pratipattyabhāvāt kathaṃ saṃketayituṃ samarthaḥ
nanu vedopi kenāyaṃ siddhaḥ svābhāvikārthabhāk | tatra saṃketayedajño jñānī dveṣadayāditaḥ || 185
yathaivecchayā ekena kṛtaḥ saṃketo'gnyādīnāndahanādiṣu tathā śvādiṣvapi
na svābhāvikoyamartha iti prasidhyati lokānusāreṇa tadarthavyavasthānāt
deśakālādibhedena nānābhūtārthadarśanaṃ | na cāpi deśakālādivyāpyartha ihi niścayaḥ || 186
abhyupagame vānyatrāpyucyatāṃ pratyakṣo dhūmādagnau pratyaya iti
anyathā vyākhyānanusāriṇopi vyākhyaiva ca saṃketa iti
atha vyākhyā na bhavati svecchākṛtasaṃketarūpā tatoyamadoṣaḥ
tadbhāvābhāvayordarśanādarśanasmṛtyapekṣa hi śabdaliṅge svaviṣayaṃ pratipādayata iti
kāryakāraṇabhāvo hi vācyavācakayoryadi | tadā śabdāt pratītiḥ syāt anumānaṃ tathā sati || 190
kriyate cecchayā tathābhūtaḥ sa paramārthataḥ kāraṇabhataḥ
na ca yamantareṇa yasya bhāvastattasya kāraṇaṃ
yo hi yasyopādānakāryatvenāpratibhāsī sa yadi paramavācyastataḥ śabdāttasyāpratibhāsanāt
yadā hyarthadarśane sati tadvivakṣayā prayogo vināśya tyantābhyāsāttadā kinna pratibhāti tasyopādānabhāvaḥ
tathā satyanumānamapi na bāhyārthaviṣayantatrāpratibhāsanādeva atha tatopi vikalpāttadadhyavasāyena vastunyevamucyate
upādānatayā yorthaḥ sthitibhāg vācya eva sa | sa copādānatecchājā pratiroddhu na śakyate || 192
tādṛk prasiddhiviṣayaḥ sarvvortho vācya ucyate | tata icchāparādhīnavṛtternna niyamo dhvaneḥ || 193
asādhāraṇatā tena śabde na pratipāditā | sā na syādyadi yogyatvād vācyannākhilamiṣyate || 194
yadi nācāryasya yogyatāyāmabhiprāyaḥ kathambādhakamanumānamasādhāraṇahetuḥ satvasyācandraśabdavācye ghaṭādike prasiddhatvāt
yadā tu yogyatāyāṃ sakalameva tadbācyatayā bhavet
yatrāpyasādhāraṇatvādanumānābhāve śabdaprasiddhena viruddhenārthenāpodyate na sa pkṣa iti
yatra viṣaye pratipakṣabhūtasyānumānasyāsādhāraṇatā tata eva tadabhāvaḥ
abhāve śābdaprasiddhamanumānaṃ bādhakaṃ na sa pakṣaḥ
uttaraṃ pūrvvasahitaṃ pūrvvamuttarasaṃhitaṃ (|) parapūrvvārthasadbhāve tadetad vyāpṛtaṃ dvyam || 195
yadā tāvat pradhānatā śābdaprasiddhasya pūrvvasyāvayavasya viśeṣaṇatā tadā pratipramāṇābhāve niścayaḥ
yadā tu parāvayavasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ pūrvvasya pradhānatā tadā'śakyaniṣedhatā
śābdaprasiddhaṃ yadrūpaṃ tatpratyakṣamatonumā | nāstyasādhāraṇatvasya vyarthakaṃ vacanaṃ na kim || 196
yogyatā hi śabdārthatayā niścitā śābdaprasiddhasyārthasya vyavahārakāritve yadi nāma pratibhāsate tathāpi tato na vyavaharttavyamiti yogyatāniṣedhaḥ
indriyavijñānena tu teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ tato na doṣaḥ
atra tu svasamvedanameva jñānasvalakṣaṇasya grahaṇaṃ na vācakatvasya
yadi nāma sattvādityasādhāraṇo hetuḥ anyo hetuḥ syādityāha
yatra hi sattvamaśeṣavastuvyāpakamasādhāraṇīkriyate tatrānyatrāvyāpake varāke kā vārttā
anyathā'śrāvaṇaḥ śabdo nityo ghaṭa ityapi hetūpanyāsaprasaṅgaḥ
atha pramāṇabādhite hetorasambhavotrāpi tathā syāditi yatkiñcidetat
nanūktamaśakyaniṣedhatāmasya darśayati smeti aśrāvaṇa ityatrāpi prasaṅgāt
śābdaprasiddhametaddhi na mukhyaṃ mānamucyate | pratipakṣavinābhāvo'ta ityatrānavadyatā || 197
atra saṃbhavati bādhakaṃ na tu pratyakṣānumānayoḥ
na hi śabdaḥ kvāpi na pravarttayituṃ śakyaḥ
necchāmātrapravṛttattvaṃ svata eva na sidhyati | śābdasiddhasya sattvasya svata eva (ā) pramāṇatā || 198
yadi tu bādhyepi bādhakatvāśaṃkā tathā sati na bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ kvacidityapratipattikaṃ jagad bhavet
śābdaprasiddhabādhāyāmasādhāraṇatā bhavet | satvasyātrāpi kāryeṇa hetunā bādhanaṃ na kim || 199
sadh‌me hi pradeśegniranumānena sādhitaḥ | pratiṣedhasya kimvanhernna (hi) sādhaka iṣyate || 200
vipakṣādbādhanāśaṅkā prāgeva vinivāritā | tasmāt pramāṇe sarvvatra pratiyogī na vidyate || 201
yatra na dṛśyate tatrāśvāsa iti cet
na hi pratibandhavānaparastatra sambhavati ekasya bhāvābhāvatvābhāvāt
nanu yadyasādhāraṇatvādanumānābhāva ityanena viruddhāvyabhicāriṇo(')bhāvasūcanānumāne tadānumāna eva kimidaṃ nocyate
yatrāpyasādhāraṇatvādanumānābhāve kāryahetusvabhāvahetuprasiddhena viruddhenārthenāpodyate tena sa pakṣa iti
pratibandhaprasiddhena vastunā'bhāvabādhanaṃ | pratibandhasya bhāve hi vastu sarvvatra vidyate || 202
yadi pratibandharahite pratyaye vastu saṃdigdhamanyathā vetyucyate
atha viparyaye tadā sarvvatra vastvastītyasādhāraṇatā pratipakṣasya
na hi tadaiva tasyaiva darśanādarśanayoḥ sambhavaḥ
soyaṃ harītakīṃ prāpya devatā virecayatīti nyāyaḥ
arthasyāsambhave'bhāvāt pratyakṣepi pramāṇatā | pratibaddhasvabhāvasya taddhetutve samaṃ dvayaṃ || 204
nanu ca tatraiva pratyakṣe'pratipakṣatvapratipādanāyānumānābhāva iti kasmānnoktaṃ yadyetāvat prayojanaṃ
apragāḍhānumānepi yatrāpratyanumānatā | tatra prauḍhānumānesau dūrādeva nirākṛtā || 206
yathaiva tasya pratikūlatā na pratīyate tathānukūlatāpi pratyakṣato'nyato vā (
) śābdaprasiddhamanumānaṃ tatra yadīcchāmātrāyāto dharmo na bādhyate vāstavaḥ
tatra kiṃ pratibandhabalāyāto bhaviṣyatītyetadevātra pratipādyaṃ prayojanaṃ
icchāmātraparādhīno'vaśyameva na bādhyate | tasya sannihitatvena sadaiva pratipattitaḥ || 207
yastu vastubalāyātaḥ sa na syādapi kutra cit | kāraṇānāṃ hi kāryeṣu niyatatvanna vidyate || 208
tato bādhakaśaṅkā syāt pramāṇe vastubhāvini | tatastatraiva yukteyaṃ bādhakasya nirākriyā || 209
daṇḍāyūpasya yo nyāyaḥ parihāra udīritaḥ | sa nāsti prathamollaṃghena tasyātikramakramaḥ || 210
na bādhitaṃ yatra parasya bādhā bhaviṣyatītyatra kathaṃ vimarśaḥ || 211
sukhopanītasya samīhitasya tyāgopi tattasya vidhāna eva
na vastuvṛttaṃ punarevamasti dharādharaḥ kampayitu (nna) śakyaḥ || 213
iti sakalamaśaṃkaṃ kāpathāvṛttijātaṃ yadi paramamunīnāṃ vṛttametanna vājñā
kathamiha duritānāṃ darśanaṃ nāstikānāmu pahatanayanānāṃ spaṣṭabhāvānadṛṣṭeḥ || 214
yadi tarhi sādhakamanumānaṃ nāstikena viparyayasyābhāvasya sādhanaṃ
tathā hi śabdaprasiddhameva kevalamatra bācakaṃ na vastubalapravṛttamanumānaṃ
nahi bācyayatvamatra pratyakṣato grahītuṃ śakyaṃ tatra vastumātrasya pratibhāsanāt
athāpi syād yadyavikalpakatvāt vastumātraṃ pratibhāti na vācyavācakabhāvaḥ
vācyavācakabhāvoyaṃ deśakālanarāntare | vyabhicārī tatastasya kāryakāraṇatā na hi || 215
kāryakāraṇabhāvo hi yadyapi paramārthato pratyakṣapramāṇasiddhastathāpi sakalajagadavijñānaprasiddhivaśāt pratyakṣavat pratibhāti
dṛṣṭametanmayā pūrvvaṃ dhūmaḥ pāvakakāraṇaḥ | sa evāyamiti jñānamanyathādeyabhāk katham || 216
yadi nāma pūrvvaṃ na vikalpitaṃ mayā pūrvvaṃ tathāpi mayā dṛṣṭameva
prāgbhāvinaḥ pratyakṣasya savikalpatānibandhanaṃ tena saha sambandhābhāvāt
na tūttarakālabhāvino vikalpasya nirvviṣayatve kathaṃ tenāvikalpakatā vyavasthāpyate
anyathā vyavahāro na syāditi na tiṣṭhenna ca pratiṣṭhet kaściditi prāptaṃ
amūḍhasmṛtisaṃskāraḥ pratipattā yadā bhavet | atītavarttamānasya pratyakṣasya nivarttane || 217
abhāvavyahārasya tadā tena pravarttanaṃ | sarvvasya jagataḥ siddhamidaṃ vastvavigānataḥ || 218
vācyavācakabhāvastu mayā pratyakṣeṇa gṛhīta iti naivaṃ kasyacitpratītiḥ
śabdārtho darśanādeva gṛhyete vācyavācakau | nopadeśamvinā sopi nopadeśastayekṣyate || 219
upadeśopi yadyanyathā kaścid brūyāt parityajedevānyathā vyākhyāvikalpo na syāt
saṃketakaraṇakāle hi yadā purovarttidevadattādināmacikīrṣāviṣayīkṛtaṃ vastu puraḥ paśyanti jantavaḥ
śrutigocaracāri ca śabdarūpaṃ yajñadatta ityādikantadā bhavatyasya saṃjñeyamiti vyavahārakārī niścayaḥ

sa cāpyupādhimān bhinnaḥ svayamevopādhibhya iti vyarthakamaparopādhikalpanaṃ
yadi ca svarūpeṇaiva bhinnaḥ, tadeva bhinnatvamupādhimadantarāpekṣāyāmapi
svarūpabhedād bhedena sarvvebhyo vinivṛttitaḥ | apareṇāpi bhedena kalpitenātra ko guṇaḥ || 365
yadyevamupādherapi bhinna iti pratīteraparo bhedo'bhyupagantavyastasmādapi bheda ityanavasthā bhedānām
svarūpeṇa hi bhedasyābhāvepi pararūpataḥ | na bhedaḥ paratā tasya bhedābhāve bhavetkathaṃ || 366
tasya hi svarūpeṇābhede para eva nāsti
atha bhedakaṃ svarūpeṇa bhinnaṃ tato'bhinnamapi dharmirūpaṃ bhetsyate
yadi tasya svarūpeṇa bhedonyasyāpyasau bhavet | apasarppato hi dūreṇa na śakyamupasarppaṇaṃ || 367
na khalu bhedaḥ paramabhindana (? n) bhedo bhavati
tasmādekasya svarūpabhede bhedasya bhedavatopi tathā sa iti na parasmād bhedaḥ
tasmāt svarūpamevāparāsaṃsargisvabhāvato bheda iti tādātmyameva bhedārthasvabhāvayoriti bheda eva vākyārthaḥ
sa eva tātparyeṇābhighātavyo'nyathā padārthābhidhānamapi na bhavet
sa ca padārthāntarād bhedaḥ svarūpataḥ pratyakṣagamyastatra saṃketakaraṇe sa eva śabdagamya iti vyavaccheda eva śabdasyābhidheyaḥ
nanu svarūpagatā sā vyāvṛttistatra svarūpānabhidhāne kathantadavyatiriktavyāvṛttyabhidhānaṃ
atha vyatiriktā vyāvṛttistadāsau svavyaktyanugatatvājjātireva bhaṅgyantareṇa pratipāditā bhavet
tathā cānugatameva rūpaṃ pratipādyaṃ na vyāvṛttiriti kathaṃ vyavacchedaphalaṃ vākyam
sa eva hi tadanyasmād vyāvṛtto ghaṭa ucyate | na tu sāmānyayogena (ā) vyāvṛttasyaiva bhinnatā || 368
tadvā na bhavedasamānasya samānatā parayogepi na yuktā
yadi na bhedagrahaṇaṃ sāmānyamityeva syādviśeṣa iti vā
bhedena pratibhāsaścet tena sāmānyavad bhavet | abhedenāvabhāsaścet sāmānyaṃ tena tad bhavet || 370
na tat sāmānyantenaiva rūpeṇa vyakterbhinnaṃ tenaiva rūpeṇābhinnaṃ kintu kenacida‌‌‌‌rūpeṇa bhinnaṃ kenacid rūpeṇābhinnamiti vyavasthā
na ca dvirūpaṃ sāmānyaṃ parasparavibhedataḥ | syātāṃ dve vastunī tatra sāmānyamaparaṃ bhavet || 371
sāmānyarūpayorbhedād vyaktitaiva prasajyate | vyaktisāmānyatāpyasya rūpabhedānna yujyate || 372
vyaktitvaṃ nanu sāmānyaṃ tadyogāt syāt samānatā
rūpadvayasya kalpe ca prasaṅgaḥ pūrvvavad bhavet
sā na vyaktau nahi sāmānyayuktā sāmānyarūpeṇa bhinnena vyavasthānāt
tataḥ pūrvvasāmānyasamānatā na syāt sāmānyāyogādanya sāmānyena vyavadhānāt
naikasyāpi tataḥ sāmānyayoga ityasamānatā | tataḥ samānākāreyaṃ pratipattiravastukā || 374
antyasamānatve hi pūrvvakaṃ sāmānyaṃ tadabhedāt pūrvvakamapīti tataḥ sāmānyabuddhiḥ sālambanā syānna caivamiti yatkiñcidetat
tato'bhinnānāṃ parasparaṃ bhedayogepi tadyuktatā nābhedabādhanīti sakalamabhinnameva bhavet
vyaktyabhede na sāmānyaṃ vyaktireva tu tad bhavet
sā ca svato na bhinneti tato'dvaitaṃ prasajyate || 375
tatkathaṃ sā vijātīyādeva nirbhakṣya śakyā pratyetuṃ
yadi svarūpasaṃgrāhī sakalaḥ pratyayo bhavet | abhinno na vibhedena śakyo bhettuṃ kathañcana || 376
sthāṇau hi davīyodeśavyavasthitena na bhedaḥ sannapi pratyetuṃ śakyaḥ
dūradeśatayā tu tasyāpratibhāsane pratibhāsamātrakaṃ samānaṃ sarvvatrotpadyata iti vyaktivyatiriktaṃ tadeva sāmānyaṃ
dṛśyavikalpyārthaikīkaraṇena tadevābhinnamiti samvṛ yā bhavati bhinna
vyaktyasaṃsargirūpasya pratibhāsena tadbhavet | sāmānyaṃ nahi sāmānyaṃ kevalaṃ vyaktirūpavat || 378
bhinnasāmānyayoge hi sāmānyānāṃ samānatā | tataḥ parantu sāmānyaṃ vyaktireva parisphuṭā || 379
tadvyaktīnāṃ samānatvāt vyaktau tarhi pratipattiḥ pravṛttiśca na syāt
yadi tarhi na sāmānyayogo vyatiriktetaratayā nāpyubhayarūpatayā na bhrāntirūpatāya
vyavacchedaphalatvena pāriśeṣyādupāyatā | śabdādarthagatau nyāyaḥ ka ivānyo bhaviṣyati || 380
tatra pratyakṣeṇa vastusvabhāvalīna eva vyatirekaḥ pratyayaviṣayaḥ
nanu vastupratipattau vyatirekasya khaṇḍaśaḥ kathaṃ pratipattiḥ
sattyāsattyatayā tu bhedamaparaṃ kaḥ kalpyed dhīdhanaḥ || 382
yāvatā vinā vastunā vyavacchedaḥ pratyetumaśakyaḥ tāvanmātraṃ vyavahāriṇāṃ prayojanaprasiddhaye prabhavati
na ca sattyavastusaṃgatameva vyavacchedanaṃ pratyetuṃ śakyamasattyasaṅgamenāpi tasya pratītidarśanāt
nanu vastusattve vyatirekasyāpi tada vyatireke tallīnasya kathaṃ sattyatā
pratīyamānamapyetadasattyamiti kaḥ kramaḥ | visamvādādasattyañced bhedaḥ sattyo na kimmataḥ || 384
yadi tena pratīyamānena rūpeṇa tadastyeva kathamasattyatā
atha prāpyarūpatā nāsti tena visamvādādasattyaṃ na svarūpataḥ
yadi yatprāptaṃ tatsattyamāyātaṃ vyavacchedasya sattyatvaṃ tasya prāpteḥ
nanvasattyavastuvyavacchedastena pratipanno na cāsau prāptaḥ sattyavastuvyavacchedaprāpteḥ
na ca prāptaparitoṣā vyavahāriṇaḥ parāparabhedaṃ niścetuṃ kṣamā yena vyavacchedabhedāvadhāraṇayā visamvādasamvedanasaṅgamaḥ
pramāṇamantareṇa pratipattau prameyasyāpīti na pramāṇādhīnaḥ prameyādhigamaḥ syāt
prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa gamyate na tu tattvataḥ | pramāṇena matistattvamanavasthā tathoditā || 386
vyavahāraḥ pramāṇañcedanavasthā niveditā | apramāṇād gatau saiva prameyepi bhaviṣyati || 387
pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ prāptaṃ vyarthakaṃ sarvvasiddhitaḥ | pramāṇena vinaiveti tadidaṃ na samañcasaṃ || 388
itastaṭamito vyāghraḥ kenāstu prāṇino gatiḥ | bhedābhede'visamvādo dvayepi hi na yujyate || 389
yadi pratīyamānāt prāpyaṃ vastu bhinnaṃ kathamanyaprāptau visamvādābhāvo'visaṃvādaśca
tathā sati tadapi tadaiva pratipannaṃ kimarthaṃ pravarttate
vyavacchedaphalaṃ vākyanna vastuviṣayaṃ kvacit | evakārāprayogepi yadebhyosti pratīyate || 390
nanu yathā pārtha eva dhanurdhara iti viśeṣyasannidhāne (nā) 'vadhāraṇāt
tatra yadi dhanurdharoyaṃ na veti dhānurdvayaṃ sandehaprakaraṇe prasa jyate caitro dhanurdhara iti (
tathā tatrāpyanyayogavyavacchedavākye yadi pratiniyataḥ pratiyogī prakṛtaḥ pārtharādheyayoḥ kaḥ kodaṇḍadharaḥ
pārtha eva dhanurdhara iti na rāmādivyavacchedaḥ
tathā yogavyavacchedepi yadi prakriyate kimanyopyasya guṇaḥ saṃvi dyate
pārthavicārepi yadi kimanyopi jagati dhanurdhara iti sandehaprakaraṇaṃ tadā sarvvaviśeṣyāntaravyavaccheda eva sarvvasya tadā pratiyogitayā prakramāt
tasya dharmasyānyena yoge prasiddhe tadayoga evāśaṃkyate
nahyanyayoge labdhe tatrāvadhāraṇaṃ tatraiva patati virodhāt
nahi svabhāvataḥ pradīpavat pratipādakā dhvanayaḥ iti pratipāditaṃ
nanu pārthasyaiva dhanurdharatvamiti viśeṣaṇenāpi sahāvadhāraṇamanyayogameva vyavacchinatti nāyogamiti prakṛtavirodhaḥ
1 nakārasya dvitvaṃ pariśodhya paścāt kṛtaṃ hastalekhe
viśeṣaṇatvaṃ pārthasya yadyapi pratipādyate | śabdena na tu tattasya paramārthena vidyate || 391
anyo hi vāstavo nyāyonyaḥ śabdanaya iti
atra ca prakaraṇād vastudharmasya grahaṇamityadoṣa eva
atrāvadhāraṇārtho vyavacchedarūpaḥ pratyakṣatonumānācca pratīyate vibhāgeneti nā pratītidoṣaḥ
anyayogavyavacchedena hi viśeṣaṇa ekasya tadbhāve 'nyasyātattvaṃ syād viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoginaśca nipātasyāviśeṣaḥ
yadi pakṣasyaiva dharmaḥ kṛtakatvantadā'nyat sakalamakṛtakaṃ bhavet

pratyakṣādvā pratipannaṃ kṛtakatvaṃ lokapratītyā cānumānalakṣaṇayā viśeṣaṇādisahacaritāvadhāraṇārthanipātasya tadarthasya cāyogavyavacchedādervvācyavācakabhāvasyānyasya vā pratītiriti kastatrānyathābhāvaḥ
bhedaḥ saṃsargo bhedasaṃsargau vā samāsavākyārtha iti vibhāgena pratīteḥ
bhavatu pakṣasya dharmaḥ sa tu navadhā kimityācārye (ṇa) nirddiṣṭaḥ
asiddhaviruddhānai kāntikasamyagghetupratipādanārthaṃ hi tāvanta eva nirddeśyā na navabhiḥ prayojanamityāha
tato'numānena vyavaccheda eva sādhya ityarthaḥ pradarśitaḥ
kathañca navatvaṃ na hi sa evāvarttamānaḥ saṃkhyābhedasyāśrayaḥ
na khalu sādhanaṃ nāma svarūpeṇa kiñcit
sādhye ca bhedasaṃsparśini sa evaikaḥ samyagdheturvviruddhaśceti na kiñcadupapannaṃ
tataḥ sakalaṃ kāryaṃ dbidhāvṛtti dvidhāvṛtti ca prayatnāna tarīyakatvaṃ
tena vyāpitvāt kāryamapi jñānaṃ svabhāvahetureva vastutaḥ
yadi nityaṃ śabdamupapādayiṣyāmastadā vyajyate śabdo'thānyathā tadā kriyata iti
na ca śabdaṃ karotīti karaṇavyavahārāt kriyate śabda iti pratīmaḥ (
tato nityasya sato vyaktireva ghaṭavacchavdasyāpi pradīpataḥ
tadatatkālayoryasya siddhirasti pramānvitā | upalambhaḥ punarvyaktirvyakteranyanna lakṣaṇam || 394
tathā prāgvidyamānasya kutaścidupalambhanaṃ | na kāryatvaṃ sataḥ pūrvvamakāryantadā vidi || 395
prayatnānantaraṃ jñānaṃ prāk sato niyamena na
yathā khalu prayatnānantarabhāvī ghaṭaḥ prayatnakāryo na kulālaprayatnavyaṅgyaḥ
) sarvvaṃ sarvvasyāstīti na kenacit kiñcidīhitavyamityanīhitaṃ jagat syāt
nānyavyāvarttanaṃ vyasya niyamo nāma vidyate | tato vyāvarttanaṃ nāsti kāraṇānāṃ śatairapi || 396
vyāvarttanamabhāvaśca punastasya kathaṅgatiḥ | avidyamānasya punargatāvudaya e saḥ || 397
sāpi kāryā yadi bhavet tatra syāt kalpanādvayam || 399
yadyasattvaṃ kriyā'śakyāsattvepi kāraṇaṃ kathaṃ | sattvāsattvantu naikasya vidyate mānasaṃgatam || 400
bhāvepi tat sadāstyeva kārakaistatra kiṃ kṛtaṃ | abhāvena kriyāśaktiriti kārakatā vṛthā || 401
tasmāt prayatnānantarabhāvī kulālādikāryo ghaṭo na vyaṅgyaḥ
yathā tarhi pradīpavyaṅgyaḥ sa eva kālāntaropalabdhaḥ tathā prayatnavyaṅgyaḥ śabdopi bhaviṣyati
pratyabhijñā kiṃ jñātaṃ sādhayati sattvamatha jñātayormadhyabhāvi
yadi jñātaṃ sādhayati tadidānīṃ jñānenaiva prāktanena sādhita smaraṇena vyavahṛtaṃ kastatra pratyabhijñāyā upayogaḥ
yadi smaraṇasadbhāvāt pratyabhijñā pravarttate | smṛterthe pratyabhijñānamanindriyajameva tat || 402
na cākṣajasmṛtīmuktvā pratyayaḥ para iṣyate | tenākṣajatvābhāvena smaraṇasyāpramāṇatā || 403
nahi smaryamāṇerthe pravarttanamakṣāṇāmanyathā kānyakubjādīnāmapi pratyakṣatā bhavet
smaraṇasyāpramāṇatvāt tatprameyaikatā kathaṃ | asattyatve hi dharmasyāsattyatvaṃ dharmiṇaḥ sphuṭam || 404
na pūrvvakālasambandhaḥ smaraṇena vineyate | rūpamātrāvabhāsastu vināpi pratyabhijñayā || 405
atha tatrāpi nittyatā kālāntarasthāyitā lakṣaṇa pratibhāsata eva
varttamānasya sattyatve pūrvvasyāsattyatāsthitau | sattyāsattyatayālīḍhā tayoḥ syādekatā dhruvaṃ || 407
dvayoḥ sattyāsattyatāyāṃ tadekatāpi sattyāsattyaiva yuktā nāsattyaiva
yadi dharmivaśenāsyāḥ sattyāsattyatayāsthitiḥ | varttamānatayā sattyā'varttamānatayā mṛṣā || 408
varttamānarūpasya sattyatvāt tadgataikatvamapi sattyaṃ dharmirūpānuvṛtteḥ (ḥ) smaryamāṇaikatā tu tata evāsattyeti prāptamato vastuna ekatā na sidhyati
ekaikatā kathannāma sattyā cet pratyayo na kim
pratyakṣe pratyakṣaṃ na pramāṇamiti vacasyapi prameyaṃ—vyākhyā
athedaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ bhinne dṛṣṭena dṛśyate | dṛśyamānaṃ tato'bhinne bhavatītyavasīyate || 410
bhedepyanyoviśeṣosti tato yena nivarttate | varaṃ viśeṣastasyaiva na tvarthāntarakalpanaṃ || 411
pratyabhijñāpratyayodayamātreṇa varaṃ bhedaviśeṣa evāsāviti kalpanaṃ natvabhedasya bhedavijātīyasyādṛṣṭaścāyaṃ pratyabhijñodayaḥ
na punaratra tatheti viṣamaḥ khalu keśapāśopanyāsaḥ
lūnatā nāma vicchedaḥ parāsaṃghaṭanaṃ sa ca | tataḥ pūrvvaparityāgād vittiḥ saṃghaṭate kutaḥ || 412
vinaṣṭe pūrvvake rūpevinaṣṭenaikatā saha | nānātvepa tathaikatvambhavati pratipāditaṃ || 413
vinaṣṭamakṣasya na gocaraḥ kvacittataḥ smṛtereva sa gocare careta
smṛteḥ pramāṇatvamapākṛtaṃ puraḥ tataḥ pramāṇānumataiva nityatā || 414
ataḥ prakāśaṃ smṛtirarthasaṃgrahe na vastvidānīṃ yadi nāma sādhayet
tadātanaṃ vastu tu gamyate tayā tataḥ pramāṇāvagatā hi pūrvvatā || 415
tayā sahaikatvaviniścayo dṛr̤haḥ kathaṃ pramāṇādaparo bhaviṣyati
dṛḍhopi saṃpratyaya utthitaḥ satāṃ parākriyeteti virodhitā svataḥ || 416
idaṃ tadbodhasarvvasvaṃ pratyabhijñānavādinām | ati dūraṃ samārūḍhā patantyeva jhaṭityapi || 417
tathā sati na smṛtiḥ hi smṛtirapūrvvārthaviṣayā bhavatu
yadātītaṃ na tada grāhyaṃ yadā grāhyaṃ na tattathā | smaryamāṇena rūpeṇa tadatītaṃ na vastu tat || 420
avisamvādasadbhāvāt pramāṇaṃ jñānamiṣyate | varttamāne'visamvādo na tu pūrvvavināśini || 422
na syād yadi tadekatvaṃ kintatorthakriyā na sā
tadarthakriyākaraṇādekatvaṃ tu tadakāri vyāvṛttilakṣaṇaṃ sāmvṛtamiṣyate eva ekamiti hi vyapadeśavikalpāstadarthasāmarthyamātreṇa samañjasajātaya
sa evāyaṃ ghaṭa iti tatsamāna iti
yadā ghaṭādanyaḥ piṭharikādika āneyatvena vivakṣitastadānyamānayetyuktau yadā tadghaṭavyaktervyaktyantarānayanaṃ tadā sa evāyaṃ ghaṭa ānīta iti vyavahāradarśanaṃ
tasmānna pratyabhijñātaḥ śabdasyaikatvaniścayaḥ | pratipādanaśaktestu samānatvāttathā bhramaḥ || 424
ekatvepi na viśvāso vyabhicārasya darśanāt | tatsamāne tathānyatra viśvasityeva kaścana || 426
atha kṣaṇikatva kathaṃ pratidānecchā ekatve (punaḥ) sutarāmeva na ghaṭate
bhayena lajjayā yuktaṃ dattasya pratipādanaṃ | bhayalajjā'dhikā yasya bhayalañje tu kiṃkṛte || 427
kṣaṇaprabandhepi sa eva vibhramaḥ kimasya naitad vyavahārakāraṇaṃ
na nittyatāyāmapi kāraṇodayāt paraḥ para syāpyabhimānakāraṇaṃ || 429
na ca vyavahāramātreṇa pīḍā pīḍā bhavati
putrapīḍayā vyatiriktayāpi sambandhāt pīḍita eveti cet
anyathā śatrupīḍayāpi pīḍitaḥ syāttenāpyupaghātyo paghātakalakṣaṇo'syāstyeva sambandhaḥ
putropi yadi śatruḥ syānna tatpīḍākṛtā kṣatiḥ
santānamātrakeṇa hi sakalaḥ sa evāyamiti vyavahāraḥ
tena śabdasya na nittyatā tataḥ kathaṃ prayatnānantaramasya vyaktiḥ
bhedātpratyayabhedena kāryatā na dhvaneḥ satī | na pradīpādibhedena vibhidyante ghaṭādayaḥ || 432
atha pradīpābhi vyaktaṃ nīlotpalaṃ raktaṃ dṛśyate
vyañjakādanyarūpatvaṃ bhāvānāṃ yadi vidyate | tadanyarūpakāratvād vyañjakaṃ kārakaṃ bhavet || 433
vyañjakena hi tadrūpaṃ hāpayatā svarūpa viparītaṃ prakāśayitavyam
tattu tasya rūpamavidyamānaṃ kathaṃ prakāśayituṃ śakyam (
vyañjakaṃ janakaṃ bhrānteryadi tad vyañjakaṃ kathaṃ
prakāśayaddhi kiñcit syād vyañjakaṃ vyañjakaṃ sphuṭam || 434
atha bhramepi tadrūpamaparaṃ parigṛhyate | dhvanestena prayatnādivyañjakosya mataḥ satām || 436
yadyapi nāmālyamahattvādiko dhvanisaṃsargācchabdasya bhedastathāpyasau bhrāntikṛta eva na tattvataḥ
bhrāntāvapi śabdasyāparaṃ tattvaṃ pratibhāsata eva sphoṭātmanaḥ
bhrāntarūpāt paraṃ rūpaṃ yadi śabdasya vidyate (|) bhedenaivāvabhāseta nānyathā bhrāntatā gatiḥ || 437
nahi bhinnamabhinnena rūpeṇa pratibhāsitaṃ (|) bhinnamityeva gamyetābhinnamevānyathā bhavet || 438
bhedopi bhrāntarūpādaparaṃ śabdasya rūpaṃ tatastasya bhedenāvabhāsanaprasaṅge punarbhrāntirevopakṣeptavyā punastadrūpabheda ityanavasthānādapratipattireva sattyaśabdātmanaḥ
bhrāntāvapi na bhrāntau sattyarūpameva śabdasya kevalamavasthitaṃ
vāsanāyāḥ prabodhasya śabdavit kāraṇaṃ matam | pāraṃparyeṇa janakaṃ na ca bhedakamiṣyate || 442
upādānasya bhedena bhedo na sahakāriṇaḥ | tatrāpi sahakāritvānna dhvanirbhedako mataḥ || 443
śabdasya tu sākṣādarthakriyā tajjñānajananaṃ tacca dūrādūrabhedena sphuṭāsphuṭatayodvegānudvegasahabhāvitayā bhidyata eva
tathā ca vastveva bhedo na bhrāntimātrakaṃ
yadi ca nityaḥ śabdaḥ syāt prayatnānantaraṃ jñānaṃ niyamena na syāt
nanu śruta evaṃ saṃketakāle sodyāpi anuvarttate
tathā kālāntarasthāyī sa tena vyajyate yadi
na ca kālāntarasthāyirūpavyaktau kālāntare vyañjakena kiñcit kṛtaṃ
avyaktasya vyañjakāpekṣā'nyathā tadāpyapara vyañjakaṃ punaraparamiti vyaktireva na syādanavasthā duḥsthitā

na khalu nāntarīyakatāsādhanaṃ darśanādarśanaṃ lakṣaṇamanvayavyatirekasādhanaṃ vinā prasidhyati
tadbhāvepi nāparasyābhāvaniyama iti na tadabhāve'bhāvasya gatiḥ, tasya vyāpakatā(')bhāvāt
na cātmā vyāpakaḥ siddhaḥ tatkathamasau prāṇādernnirvvarttakaḥ
ātmā hi na svayaṃ deśakālayorvvinivarttate nityatāvyāptisadbhāvāt
tatastairvināpi kāryasya bhavato'nyasmāt kathaṃ tajjaṃ rūpaṃ
nanu sāmagrībhedād bheda iti kuta etat
ātmā prakalpyate'dṛṣṭaḥ prāṇādeḥ pratibandhataḥ | niyamena vinā tasya pratibandhaḥ kathanna saḥ || 546
athātmanā prerakeṇa vinā na prāṇādayastata ātmā bhastrādhmāpayiteva pratīyate
bhastrādhmāpayitā hi sakriyaḥ sa prerakaḥ tathā'vyāpitayā na tvevamātmā
gavākṣakāntaritaśca karaṇacakṣurādisamanvitaḥ puruṣa ātmā tu naivaṃbhūtaḥ kathaṃ prekṣakaḥ

tathā ca tairvvinā bhavato'nyasmādapi śakramūrddhāderbhavataḥ kathamagnijanyatā
) tasmādanyatopi bhavato na tatkāryatā nāpyanyakāryateti kāryaka raṇabhāva eva syāt
tathā sati kāryabhedābhedau kāraṇabhedābhedāyattāviti tadabhāvānna syātāṃ
nīlaṃ hi nīlavijñānāt pratītiniyame sati (|) pratīyate'nyathā naiva bhrāntā'bhrāntavivecanaṃ || 548
yadi hīdṛśī sāmagrī bhrāntetarapratyayajaniketi niyamastadā bhavetprameyapratiniyamaḥ

sāmagrīśaktibhedāddhi bhāvānāṃ viśvarūpatā | sā cedabhedikā prāptamekarūpamidaṃ jagat || 550
) tatognireva dhūmasya janaka iti na vyabhicāraḥ kāryahetoḥ
yena tu rūpeṇa bhinnaṃ tadajanakameva kuto vyabhicārāśaṅkā

bhinnābhinnaḥ kimasyātmā bhinne ca dravatā kathaṃ
bhinnātha—he॰ na bhinno devatā kathamiti pāṭhāntaraṃ
tadanyavyāvṛttyā tu tathā vyapadeśa iti na vyabhicāraḥ

dahanapratyayāṅgatāmantareṇa notpadyate dhūma iti na tadvyabhicāraḥ

etadeva kuto na hyadṛṣṭaṃ niyamamarhati nānyathā bhavatīti
tathā sati nīlameva na bhavatīti cet
nanu svarūpalakṣaṇaṃ nīlādi na svarūpābhāve sati
na ca janyatālakṣaṇaṃ dhūmādikaṃ tatrāpi (sva)rūpameva lakṣaṇamiti na samānametat
svarūpamātranīlapītādyavabhāsanaṃ hi bhrāntābhrāntapratyayasamānamiti na vastu sidhyati
vastumātrānubandhī vināśa iti prāk pratipāditoyamartha iti punarnna carvvitacarvvaṇasya vidhānaṃ
tasmādanvayavyatirekalakṣaṇa eva kāryakāraṇabhāva iti nātmanā prāṇādīnāmiti na gamakāḥ
sakalavyatirekahetūdāharaṇasāmyakathanārthamācāryeṇa śrāvaṇatvasya vyatirekiṇo naikāntikapratipādanaṃ kṛtamiti sarvvoyaṃ nyāya ācāryasyāpyabhiprāya(stha) iti mantavyam
sapakṣācca vipakṣācca vyatireko na bhāvikaḥ | sambhavyadṛṣṭimātreṇa vyatirekīti kathyate || 552
bhāvābhāvayoḥ parasparaparihāravirodhasya bhāvikatvādanyathā'vyavahāra masamaṃjasaṃ jagat syāt
yadi nityādanityācca vyāvṛttaṃ śrāvaṇatvaṃ na bhavedeva tarhi niradhikaraṇatvāt
nityānityatvasandehe śabde hetūpapācanaṃ | sa cedubhayato hīnaḥ sandehotra tayoḥ kathaṃ || 553
na tarhi śrāvaṇatvaṃ sapdehahetuḥ śabdatvamātreṇaiva sandehāt
nanu śabdatvāt sandehe kimapareṇāpi na sandehahetutābhājā bhāvyam
nanu yo hi kvacid dṛṣṭaḥ soparatra dṛśyamānastatra śaṅkāmupajanayet
dṛṣṭe vidhividhānena saṃdehetra niṣedhataḥ | bhāvābhāvena saṃdehe kaḥ svapakṣaparigrahaḥ || 554
sa darśanadvāreṇa vidhimukhena asādhāraṇe tu pratiṣedhamukheneti tu konayorviśeṣaḥ
nanu na dṛṣṭaṃ śrāvaṇatvaṃ nityānityayoriti tayorapratipattihetureva yuktaṃ
vyāvṛttirekasya yadā niyamāt pratiyoginaḥ | vṛtyābhāvyavirodhe hi vyāvṛttirnoṃbhayorapi || 555
naikānte dvābhyāṃ parasparavirodhibhyāṃ vyāvṛttisambhava audāsīnyaṃ tvatra na labhyata eva
nanu dvayorekatra pramāṇābhāvādeva sandeho na śrāvaṇatvahetukṛtaḥ
yadi paraṃ tadapratipatti (hetu)reva, sādhāraṇānaikāntikepi tarhi pramāṇābhāvādeva sandeho na sahetukṛtaḥ
atha sandehe sati na saṃdehavyāvṛttistata iti saṃdehaheturucyate
prameyatvaṃ dvayordṛṣṭaṃ dvayornniścayakṛnna kim | dvayordarśanayoge hi vidhāne syād dvayorapi || 556
evantarhi pakṣa eva saṃdeho na spakṣadvārakaḥ
darśaneṃpi pakṣasaṃdehadvāraka eva saṃśayaḥ sa ubhayatrādarśanepi samānaḥ
yohi dvābhyāṃ rāśyantarāsambhavibhyāṃ vyāvṛttaḥ sa tenaiva rūpeṇāpratipatterhetuḥ
yo hyasādhāraṇaḥ sādhanadharmaḥ sa yāvatā bhedena sarvvasaṃgrahastatra saṃśayahetuḥ tadvatā tatsaṃgrahādekāntavyāvṛtteśca tatkathamayaṃ vyāvṛttereva saṃśayāt saṃśayahetuḥ
vyāvarttakañca tatraiva punaḥ saṃdehakṛt katha | tadvyāvṛtterdvayoranyanna vyavacchedasādhanam || 558
yo hi yasmāda vyāvṛttaḥ sa kathantasya na vyavacchedasādhakaḥ
sarvvasya hetorhetutvaṃ vyavacchedaprasādhane | vyāvṛttiḥ śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ prasādhyata iti sthitaṃ || 559
iha tu na kiñcidanyadākṣipyate dvayorapi nivṛtteḥ
śrāvaṇatvena tu yadi dvayamapi vyavacchinnaṃ tadanyathātvavidhānaṃ pratyakṣasiddhambhavediti hetureva bhavet
anyena (tu) hetunā tadekasādhanena na heturiti cet
tato parasya pareṇa vidhānaṃ niṣedhanamvā na śrāvaṇatvena
anyathā tatrāpyapareṇa vidhānamiti kathamaparasyāpi pramāṇatā bhavediti sarvvatrānāśvāsaḥ
vidhānaṃ vastupratipādanaṃ na ca vastu tadaparavyatiriktaniṣedhamantareṇa pratipāditaṃ bhavati
anyāsaṃsargi tadvastu bhavedvānyena miśritaṃ | anyena miśraṇe vastu na syādavyavahārataḥ || 561
tathā vā na niṣedhasya parasmādapi sambhavaḥ || 562
sa eva hi parasya tatra niṣedho yatparihāreṇa tasya rūpāntaratayā pratibhāsanaṃ
pratyakṣeṇa pratītasya parasmād yadi bādhanaṃ | pratyakṣasyāpramāṇatve parasyāpyapramāṇatā || 563
yena rūpeṇa (ā) miśraṇaṃ tenāpi rūpeṇa pratyakṣeṇa gṛhītameva
(pareṇa pratītau vyāvṛttatāvagama iti cet) pareṇa(ānyathā) pratītau sarvvatrānāśvāsa iti pratipāditaṃ
uṣṭrāt praviṣṭamātrasya yonyathā garbbhaveśmani | pratibhāsaḥ parodhyakṣastena pūrvvasya bādhanaṃ || 564
tena tad bādhyate na tu pramāṇameva
tasmād yadi pratyakṣeṇobhayavyāvṛttaśabdagrahaṇaṃ tadā na parasmāt saṃdehonyathā vā tathā śrāvaṇatvena vā
naikāntena niścaye vyāvṛtterityarthopi tvekāntasya niścayasya vyāvṛtteriti
nahi nitye'nitye vāsya bhāvenābhāvena vā niścayaḥ
asatāmapi kathañcit prameyatā'styevānyathā vidhiniṣedhāmyāṃ vyavahāra eva na bhavet
parasparaparihāreṇa hi vyavyasthitāḥ padārthātmāno vyavahāraviṣayo 'nyathārthakriyāvirahādanarthatā syāt
nahi parapakṣamasada pratiyatā svapakṣaḥ śakyaḥ samarthayituṃ
ākāśañca sa pratighapadārthābhāvamātramavaśyaṃ pramātavyamanyathā na padāt padamapi calitavyamāpatet
tasmāt sataḥ padārthān pratiniyamena vyavasthāpayatā prameyo'bhāva evaṃ sa vyavasthāpitaḥ
tasmād vyavahārāvisamvādasādhanapratyayaparicchedyatvāt prameya evābhāva iti nāvyabhicaritānvayaṃ prameyatvāditi
tathā sati pratyakṣasya vastuna udayādarthakriyāsāmarthyameva prameyatvaṃ

tatra ca (darśitaḥ) sa eva dvividhaḥ pratibandha iti siddhapratibandhikaivānupalavdhiḥ
ātmatve hetubhāve vā siddhe hi vyatirekitā

) na khalu jñānameva padārthasya sattājñānavyatirekeṇāpi tasyābhāvāt
sattā parokṣāpyarthānāmanumānena gṛhyate | pāvakasya na kimbhāvo dhūmadṛṣṭyānumīyate || 568

na hi parasparamabhāvānāṃ paramārthataḥ kaścid bhedaḥ

yo vā sāṃkhyotyantavimūḍhaḥ sarvvaṃ sarvvatra vidyata ityāgrahavāt

nanu sambandhe sati tadabhāve na bhavati
sambandhe sati tadbhāve bhavatīti yadīṣyate | tadabhāvepi sambandhaḥ pūrvvakasyeti cintyatāṃ || 572

ekatra vyarthaḥ paratrāsamartha iti pratyapādīdaṃ prāgeva

yathā upalabhe iti vikalpaviṣayatvāttathādhyavasīyamāna upalambhastathā nopalabhe iti vyavasāyādanupalambhopi
yadi na viśiṣṭaṃ vedanaṃ vedanāntaraviviktaṃ bhavet
yadi ca svasambedanena tadrūpasamvedanasyānanubhavaḥ tadā tasyāpi viśiṣṭatā na gamyate
yadi tu na pratyakṣādeva bhedaḥ api tvabhāvapramāṇataḥ
abhāvena pramāṇena yadi bhedasya kalpanā | sopyabhāvaḥ pareṇānyābhāve naivāvatāryate || 577

atha tathāpi nābhāvamantareṇa bheda iti nābhāvasya vyarthatā
abhyupagamya cedamucyate na tu punaḥ sambhavatīdānīṃ gṛhyamāṇasya tadā pratiyogitayā smaraṇaṃ yena tadānīmabhāvāvatāre tasyāsmād bhedagrahaṇamiti na sambhavatyabhāvāvatāraḥ

viśiṣṭarūpānubhave hi padārthānubhava eva na syāt
